name: TCL 55C7K
summary: TCL 55C7K QD-Mini LED ships with a Samba TV viewing tracker and TCL ads. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This UK TCL QD-Mini LED runs Google TV on Android 14. It ships with Samba TV, which tracks what you watch, and TCL analytics, log upload and account sign-in nags. It also carries TCL Live FAST channels, TCL content pushed to the home screen at boot, push messages, retail demo apps and a cleaner.

The list was applied on a real unit, though not yet lived with for days. Wi-Fi stayed up, the Inputs menu listed HDMI 1 to 4 and Live TV, and after a reboot Home and Wi-Fi came back. TidyTV saves a backup first, never deletes anything and lets you switch any app back on.
keep: Live TV and HDMI (the TCL TV app)
The TCL input service, Quick panel and remote pairing
UK catch-up apps (BBC iPlayer, ITVX, Channel 4, BBC Sounds)
Two TCL system agents whose purpose is unclear
notes: Wi-Fi saved during first setup may belong to the setup app. Forget and rejoin it in Settings before that app is turned off.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 55C7K?
faq.a: Not with the default list, which turns off Google Assistant voice by the owner's choice. Switch it back on in the app if you use the mic button.

faq.q: Will it stop the ads on the home screen?
faq.a: It turns off the TCL content rows, Live FAST channels, TCL tweaks to the Google TV home and the push messages and promos.
Miracast and TCL's T-Cast phone mirroring are on the list by choice and switched off. Switch them back on in the app if you use them.
